ValidationRule.description: Requires that if any Policy Exception fields are not blank, all Policy Exception fields must not be blank prior to Approval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Approved'), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Policy_Exception_Categories__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Allowable_Exceptions__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Strong_Mitigating_Factors__c)) ), OR( ISBLANK(Policy_Exception_Categories__c), ISBLANK(Allowable_Exceptions__c), ISBLANK(Strong_Mitigating_Factors__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All Policy Exceptions must be entered before Approval can be issued.
